description: User settings for authama. Precedence: command-line flags > environment > <config home>/.env > authama.json > defaults.

$schema.description: The schema this file follows (for editors).

age_recipient.description: The age recipient (public key) bundles are encrypted to. Required for `ssh bundle` and the backups destructive commands take first. Sets $AUTHAMA_AGE_RECIPIENT.

old_key_max_age_days.description: Days an archived predecessor key may stay before doctor flags it; 0 turns the check off. Sets $AUTHAMA_OLD_KEY_MAX_AGE_DAYS. Default: 90.

snapshot_retain.description: How many ~/.ssh snapshots to keep. Sets $AUTHAMA_SNAPSHOT_RETAIN. Default: 10.

mode.description: How `ssh git` rewrites remotes. Sets $AUTHAMA_GIT_MODE. Default: the manifest's defaults.git.mode, else profile.

enabled.description: Record every change in the history database (`authama history`). Sets $AUTHAMA_HISTORY. Default: true.

desktop.description: Show desktop notifications for keys due for rotation and dangling keys. Sets $AUTHAMA_NOTIFICATIONS. Default: true.

age_identity_file.description: The age identity (private key) `ssh restore` decrypts bundles with. Sets $AUTHAMA_AGE_IDENTITY_FILE.

state_dir.description: Where authama keeps its own state: the history database and audit log, snapshots, bundles, the lock and caches. Sets $AUTHAMA_STATE_DIR. Default: $XDG_STATE_HOME/authama or ~/.local/state/authama.

tokens_catalog.description: A catalog.json to use instead of the built-in token services and providers. Sets $AUTHAMA_TOKENS_CATALOG. Default: the built-in catalog.

tokens_config.description: The token config: which environment variables build which registry credential. Sets $AUTHAMA_TOKENS_CONFIG. Default: ./authama-tokens.json, else <config home>/tokens.json.

auto_pin.description: Pin a new host's key on first use (trust on first use) when a profile is minted. Sets $AUTHAMA_AUTO_PIN. Default: true.

docker_creds_store.description: What to do with registries Docker keeps in a credential store: store them with `docker login` or refuse and warn. Sets $AUTHAMA_DOCKER_CREDS_STORE. Default: ask at a terminal, else refuse.
